description: This file implements the adbd authentication logic for Android, including socket handling, packet processing, user prompts, and TLS device notifications.

classes.name: AdbdAuthPacketAuthenticated
classes.description: Packet indicating a public key has been authenticated.

classes.name: AdbdAuthPacketDisconnected
classes.description: Packet indicating a public key has been disconnected.

classes.name: AdbdAuthPacketRequestAuthorization
classes.description: Packet requesting user authorization for a public key.

classes.name: AdbdPacketTlsDeviceConnected
classes.description: Packet indicating a TLS device has connected with a specific transport type.

classes.name: AdbdPacketTlsDeviceDisconnected
classes.description: Packet indicating a TLS device has disconnected.

classes.name: AdbdAuthContext
classes.description: Main class managing authentication state, socket handling, and packet processing.

methods.name: adbd_auth_new
methods.description: Creates a new AdbdAuthContext instance with provided callbacks.

methods.name: adbd_auth_run
methods.description: Starts the main event loop for handling authentication.

methods.name: adbd_auth_get_public_keys
methods.description: Iterates over stored public keys, invoking callback for each.

methods.name: adbd_auth_notify_auth
methods.description: Notifies that a public key has been authenticated.

methods.name: adbd_auth_notify_disconnect
methods.description: Notifies that a public key has been disconnected.

methods.name: adbd_auth_prompt_user
methods.description: Prompts user for authorization of a public key.

methods.name: adbd_auth_prompt_user_with_id
methods.description: Prompts user with a specific ID for authorization.

methods.name: adbd_auth_tls_device_connected
methods.description: Notifies that a TLS device has connected with a specific transport type.

methods.name: adbd_auth_tls_device_disconnected
methods.description: Notifies that a TLS device has disconnected.

methods.name: adbd_auth_get_max_version
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported version of the auth protocol.

methods.name: adbd_auth_supports_feature
methods.description: Indicates whether a specific feature is supported (always false here).
